correctness.rationale: In F_(2^r), alpha^8=t gives an additive bijection w -> (w⁴+alpha w²+w,alpha²w⁴+w²) with inverse w⁸=z+y², hence exactly q smooth affine points and no smooth points at X=0. Any affine line restricts to a nonzero additive polynomial of degree <=4, so intersections have cardinality 0,1,2,4 (never 3). Its degree-three direction map for nonzero parameters is (w³+alpha w+1)/(alpha²w³+w); characteristic-two cubic cyclic resolvent yields a genus-one Artin–Schreier double cover for Delta=1+alpha³ !=0. Special direction/pole accounting gives #E(Fq)=6+6s4 and the stated N_j. At Delta=0 the separate trace computation gives (q-2)/6 for odd r, (q-4)/6 for even r. An independently coded polynomial-basis finite-field enumerator checked the full rational point set, direction weights, exceptional count and elliptic point count for every t!=0 in q=4,8,16,32,64. These tests corroborate but do not prove all r; the resolvent proof does.
